### Wisdom from the Psalms 6/6
Author: Dan Dick
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-6-or-6-552370.html
Passage: Psalm 72:6
Points:
- Physical drought shows how devastating a prolonged lack of life-giving water can be.
- Believers often go through seasons of spiritual drought marked by apathy and doubt.
- During dry spiritual seasons, people may feel as though God is silent or distant.
- Human souls cannot survive without the refreshing living water that Jesus provides.
- Believers can ask God to pour out His Spirit and revive their hearts.
